detail.longDescription:
HelloSix: SceneUp is a writing desk for one scene at a time.

You write the pages. Next to them you pin what this scene looks like, who is in it, how it sounds, and how it moves. Research stays on this scene. It is not a movie browser and there is no Discover page.

WRITE
• Split a notebook into scenes with INT/EXT and Day/Night
• Keep characters in a list you can pin a face to
• Focus mode for the page in front of you
• Export as text, Fountain, or PDF — the manuscript, selected scenes, or this scene’s research

PIN TO THIS SCENE
• Place — stills and walking videos, or a location photo you took
• Face — search an actor, or pick from a film’s credits
• Voice — interviews, or a line you record yourself
• Rhythm — trailers, for pace

YOUR PAGES STAY HERE
No HelloSix: SceneUp account. No HelloSix: SceneUp server. Manuscripts live on this device, with iCloud when you are signed in. Search only runs when you tap Search. Video plays in the official YouTube player. HelloSix: SceneUp does not download finished films or capture frames from the player.

This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Video comes from YouTube.
